head_commit.subject: feat(poly-robot): harden live trading runtime and controls

outcomes: CLOB execution hardening completed for pre-trade checks, secret provenance/rotation validation, and reconciliation pathways.
Runtime supervisor control state wiring completed for kill-switch and cancel-all behavior with auditable metadata propagation.
Runtime web GUI control-plane routes and operator actions extended for emergency controls.
Corrupted integration adapter tests repaired and aligned to current adapter guardrail behavior.
Milestone C sequence/certification assets and runner coverage are present and validated.

session_learnings.learning: Poly-Robot baseline test entrypoint is unittest discovery, not pytest, for environment portability.
session_learnings.action: Keep unittest commands as canonical in CI and contributor docs.

session_learnings.learning: Time-sensitive secret-rotation tests can fail when fixed historical timestamps age out.
session_learnings.action: Use non-stale rotation fixtures or controlled time injection for deterministic secret-policy tests.

session_learnings.learning: Dynamic metadata dictionaries in adapters need explicit typing to satisfy static analysis and avoid drift.
session_learnings.action: Maintain explicit dict[str, Any] annotations in dynamic payload assembly paths.

carry_over_workspace_state.note: These carry-over edits are intentionally preserved for the next phase and were not discarded.
